title: Post-marketing safety of lonapegsomatropin (Skytrofa): FAERS disproportionality analysis with active comparators and systematic review – aggregate outputs and analysis code

creators.name: Hannah-Shmouni, Fady
creators.affiliation: Division of Endocrinology, Department of Medicine, University of British Columbia; Hormonaly Inc.

creators.name: Stratakis, Constantine A.
creators.affiliation: Hospital for Endocrine Surgery Research Center, HCA Florida Healthcare, HCA Healthcare Research Institute, Tampa, FL, USA

description:
Aggregate outputs and analysis code supporting the manuscript "Post-marketing safety of lonapegsomatropin: a disproportionality analysis of US Food and Drug Administration adverse event reports with active comparators and a systematic review" (under review). Prospectively registered protocol: OSF doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/UB6W2.

Contents: aggregate disproportionality tables (ROR, PRR, BCPNN IC, MGPS EBGM) for lonapegsomatropin vs all drugs and vs daily somatropin and somatrogon; prespecified event groups; paediatric/adult strata; sensitivity analyses; quarterly report counts; whole-database background PT counts; figures; systematic-review search results and extraction tables (published literature); Python 3.12 code to reproduce everything from the public FDA FAERS quarterly ASCII files (2010Q4-2026Q3 downloaded for deduplication; analysis window 2021Q3-2026Q3). No case-level FAERS rows, report identifiers or individual-level data are included.
